01Introduction

Welcome to HT Tools, also known as HT Tools Abacus & Math, developed and published by HT Skills Hub. This policy explains how the educational application handles information on Windows and Android, including when used by children.

The application provides interactive Japanese Soroban and Chinese Suanpan, mathematics and speed practice, Auto Counting, Mixed Math, a calculator and a Study Book. Its standard Windows learning tools are designed for offline use.

02Information we handle

No online account or registration is required for standard offline learning. Users may create local learner profiles with a name or nickname. Profile names can be personal information; we recommend using a nickname rather than a child’s full name.

The standard offline features do not request email addresses, telephone numbers, physical addresses, identification documents, precise location or payment information.

03Offline functionality

Standard educational activities can be completed without a continuous internet connection. In the reviewed Windows source, educational resources and calculations are handled on the device. The application uses a local API bound to the loopback address (127.0.0.1) to communicate between its interface and local runtime; this is not a remote cloud service.

04Windows application and runFullTrust

The Windows desktop application uses bundled runtime components, libraries and local resources. Its MSIX package may declare the runFullTrust capability to support execution of the traditional desktop application and its offline functionality. This capability is not intended to request administrator privileges or bypass Windows security controls.

Standard operating system resources include display, audio output, keyboard, mouse and local storage.

05Android application

HT Tools is also intended for compatible Android devices. Available features and permissions may vary by release. The intended offline learning experience uses standard device functions such as touchscreen input, display, audio output and local storage. Users can review or manage permissions in Android settings.

Any release that introduces additional data collection, permissions or external services will require an updated disclosure as applicable.

06Children’s privacy

HT Tools is designed for education, including use by children. Standard offline learning does not require children to register online or provide contact details. Local learner names and practice records may be entered or generated on the device. Parents, guardians and teachers are encouraged to use nicknames and supervise shared-device use.

HT Skills Hub does not intend to collect children’s personal information through the standard offline learning tools or share it with advertising networks.

07Advertising and third-party services

The current offline Windows application is not designed to display advertising or use advertising networks or analytics services to track learners. Software libraries and development frameworks may be bundled to support functionality. Any future advertising, analytics or external service that changes these practices will be disclosed in an updated policy.

08Local data storage

The application may retain the following information locally to support learning and personalization:

  • Learner profile names or nicknames, profile identifiers and role settings.
  • Scores, correct and incorrect answers, practice durations, activity history and timestamps.
  • Abacus values, calculator activities and exercise preferences.
  • Theme, bead style and color, sound, timer and other configuration settings.

The reviewed Windows source uses a local SQLite database, normally located at %LOCALAPPDATA%\HTTools\ht_tools.sqlite3, and browser-based local storage for certain preferences. Actual locations may vary by installation or operating system.

Records remain on the device during normal offline operation. Local records may persist after closing the app or uninstalling it, depending on platform and packaging behavior. Classroom profile switching is not a security or authentication boundary.

09Data sharing and exports

HT Skills Hub does not sell users’ personal information. The standard offline Windows learning tools are not designed to transmit learner records to HT Skills Hub servers or external analytics services. Users may choose to export available scores or activity records; exported files are under the user’s control and may contain profile names or educational history. Please share them carefully.

10Internet connectivity

Standard offline learning does not require internet access. Store downloads, updates, external support links and any future optional online resources may require connectivity. If future functionality changes how information is collected or transmitted, this policy will be updated.

11Data security

HT Skills Hub aims to minimize unnecessary access to information. Users should keep their operating systems updated, obtain the application from trusted sources and protect access to shared devices and exported records. No application can guarantee absolute security.

12User rights and choices

Users and guardians can adjust available settings, manage permissions, clear supported local history, remove locally stored application data where supported, uninstall the application or contact the developer. Uninstalling may not remove all local files or exported copies. On Windows, users can close the app and remove its local data folder if necessary; this may permanently delete saved progress and preferences. On Android, applicable app storage controls are available through device settings.

Because normal offline learning records are stored on the device, the developer generally cannot retrieve or erase those records remotely.

13Microsoft Store and Google Play

HT Tools may be distributed through Microsoft Store, Google Play or other authorized channels. Microsoft and Google may independently process information related to their stores, operating systems, downloads and updates under their own privacy policies. These practices are separate from the application’s offline data handling.

14Future updates

HT Skills Hub may introduce new educational activities, features and device support. If an update materially changes information collection, processing, storage or sharing, the relevant privacy disclosures will be revised.

15Changes to this policy

We may update this policy to reflect changes in functionality, applicable laws or privacy requirements. Updates will be published on this page with a revised date. Users are encouraged to review the policy periodically.

17Our commitment to privacy

We believe educational technology should be accessible, reliable and respectful of privacy. HT Tools is developed with a focus on interactive learning, simplicity and children’s education. We are committed to improving the application while respecting the privacy and safety of its users.
